prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent sprite animation sheet for a polished flat-shaded 2D cartoon action game with black-red-cream UI. Camera frontal with slight 2.5D overhead, all effects at same central ground pivot, consistent style. Style: hand-painted clean anime cartoon VFX, strong broad filled shapes and clear light/shadow planes, bold readable cloud silhouettes, subtle local emissive edge glow. Not photorealistic, not pixel art. NO semicircle, NO outlined circle, NO hollow donut, NO speed-line-only effect, NO thin wires, NO repetitive radial sticks, NO large star cross. Make them usable at 50-150 pixels on a dark game map, vivid and substantial but compact.
usage: Runtime 4-column / 2-row equal sprite cells; fire row 0, icy magical impact row 1; preserve generated alpha.
